configuration: September 2026 launch configuration with persistent user VM memory, goals/background work, browser sub-agent and Sentinel controls.
sources_read: https://introducing.muse.ai/ — content snapshot; version not displayed.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Conversational details enter persistent memory: Muse remembers information mentioned once, and users can request deletion of learned information.
S->M.locator: [Launch documentation](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-personal-ai-agent/), How It Works and Built to be Private, Safe, and Secure, lines 262 and 279.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Remembered personal details guide unsolicited suggestions and task execution, including considering friends’ dietary restrictions before sending invitations.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: Muse delegates tasks to its browser sub-agent, which reads pages and traverses sites; Action therefore determines subsequent observation targets.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: The retained harmful-site list is matched inside the VM to interpret browser destinations as known threats, before the navigation decision.
M->S.quote: match against that list inside the user’s VM

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Plans and completed actions are retained in the audit trail and activity log.
A->M.locator: [Launch documentation](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-personal-ai-agent/), Built to be Private, Safe, and Secure, line 275; [Design documentation](https://introducing.muse.ai/), Background work and transparency and Goals and tracking, lines 47–52.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The service keeps a user-accessible history of its actions and plans.
record.locator: [Launch documentation](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/09/introducing-muse-personal-ai-agent/), Built to be Private, Safe, and Secure, line 275.
record.quote: Muse shows people a complete audit trail of everything it has done and plans to do.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Replies to delivered approval requests update retained approval state, including permissions extending beyond one invocation.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Sentinel binds each reply to the proposed operation and permits or rejects it accordingly, providing an immediate in-service check.
attribution.quote: allows the operation to proceed or rejects it as appropriate.

revision.label: stated
revision.rationale: Muse builds its own executable tools and custom connectors; generated code is kept in its persistent VM, constituting a tool-code mechanism extension.
revision.locator: [Design documentation](https://introducing.muse.ai/), Muse Is an Agent That Can Actually Do Things, line 30; [Safety documentation](https://research.meta.ai/blog/security-and-safety-for-ai-agents-our-approach-with-muse), introduction, line 17; Connectors, line 38; Our Policy Around Data, lines 136–137.
revision.quote: write its own code and build the tools a task needs.
revision.what: Agent-authored executable tool and custom-connector code.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: No later run is explicitly identified as using an agent-authored mechanism revision; general self-editing and code-execution capabilities do not establish this.

notes: Text-only review; no code repository. Future Confidential VM is excluded. M→S concerns harmful-site priors. Outcome and attribution concern approval replies, not demonstrated post-execution success.
